seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player,portal] show mixed outcomes: x x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Arrows move player 3; next rect overlapping a block kicks the push chain, which slides 1 cell/tick until a member hits colour 2, HUD row, the player or a non-fitting socket interior; player stays.
Walls read from frame colours: 2 blocks everything, 15 terrain blocks only the player, socket rim 4 passable, socket interior only for exact-fit blocks.
Click on a block: player takes its rect; old player rect stays painted as an empty token (rim 14, centre 4), not extracted.
Render: token rim 14, centre 5 (blocks) / 0 (player); player edges adjacent to a block drawn 0; HUD row 63 = ceil(actions/2) zeros from the right.
Hypothesis: block A3 mixed outcome = whether the player next rect overlaps it (kick), not an own field. Unconfirmed: whether the empty token blocks; HUD parity needs continuity (stateless 17/29).
